description: Class representing the currently active workbook

Calculate.description: Recalculates the cells that need recalculation (changed, added or volatile) across the workbook. Forces the recalc that is otherwise deferred until a macro finishes, so up-to-date formula results can be read within the same macro.

GetActiveChart.description: Returns the active chart of the workbook.

GetActiveSheet.description: Returns the active sheet of the workbook.

GetAllPivotTables.description: Returns all pivot tables in the workbook.

GetCustomProperties.description: Returns the custom properties of the workbook.

GetDrawingsByName.description: Returns drawings with the specified names from the workbook.

returns.description: Returns an array of drawing obkects filtered by the specified names.

GetName.description: Returns the name of the workbook.

GetSheets.description: Returns a sheet collection that represents all the sheets in the workbook.

GetTheme.description: Returns the theme of the workbook.

Redraw.description: Redraws the editor screen, making the changes already made by a macro visible without waiting for it to finish. Observable from asynchronous code only. Repaints without recalculating: call {@link ApiWorkbook#Calculate} first if formula results must be up to date.

Save.description: Saves changes to the specified document.
